ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The following figure is a schematic diagram of sea-level pressure in a certain month near 30°N (unit: hPa). Read the figure and answer the following questions. <image1> According to the season reflected in the figure, what wind prevails in northern Australia?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows an east-west sea-level pressure profile near 30°N, extending roughly from 30° to 120° longitude horizontally. In the figure, the pressure values are higher on both sides, about 1004 hPa; they decrease toward the middle, with about 1000 hPa near 60°, a low-value area of about 996 hPa appearing near 70°—80°, rising again to 1000 hPa near 90°, and 1004 hPa near 120°. This low-pressure area is located near India or near the Asian interior. From this it can be judged that the Asian continent is heated and forms a continental thermal low, and the month shown reflects summer in the Northern Hemisphere. The seasons in the Northern and Southern Hemispheres are opposite, so northern Australia is in winter at this time. In winter, northern Australia is controlled by the southeast trade winds and the southeast wind prevails.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中30°N沿线的气压分布，确认在亚洲内陆或印度附近出现低压中心；再根据大陆热低压判断图示月份为北半球夏季；由南北半球季节相反推出澳大利亚北部为冬季；最后调用澳大利亚北部冬季盛行东南信风的规律，得到风向为东南风。
method.CoT_raw: 图像显示的是30°N附近一条东西向海平面气压剖面，横向大致从30°到120°经度。图中气压值在两侧较高，约为1004 hPa；向中部降低，60°附近约1000 hPa，70°—80°附近出现约996 hPa的低值区，90°附近又回升到1000 hPa，120°附近为1004 hPa。这个低压区位于印度附近或亚洲内陆附近。由此可判断，亚洲大陆受热形成大陆热低压，图示月份反映北半球夏季。南北半球季节相反，因此此时澳大利亚北部为冬季。澳大利亚北部冬季受东南信风控制，盛行东南风。
